# @kerfjs/ui component reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

One short page per catalog entry. Pick a component by the interface need from the one-line purposes below, then open only the pages you use. Each page lists when to use and avoid it, imports and CSS/registration side effects, where its exact props live, legal parents, zones with their JSX props and child counts, which state the app owns and which a wiring helper owns, geometry ownership, accessibility obligations, the styling boundary (configure through props; never override internals), and its `KUI-C` diagnostics.

Exact prop and callback types live in [`public-api-signatures-v1.md`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md) (Web Awesome JSX in [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md)). Tools and linters read the canonical machine sources instead: [`component-catalog.json`](../component-catalog.json) (selection and delivery) and [`component-composition.json`](../component-composition.json) (composition), joined by `package:id`. Prefer a Kerf UI component over a Web Awesome element whenever both fit.

## Kerf UI — Foundation

- [Badge](./badge.md) — Present compact metadata without application-authored badge CSS or consumer styling of component internals.
- [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md) — Decorative and meaningfully labeled Lucide-compatible icons.
- [DisclosureArrow](./disclosure-arrow.md) — Indicate whether a disclosure control is open with an overridable 18px root-scaled visual and shortest-path rotation behavior.
- [Foundation tokens](./foundation.md) — Provide the shared semantic token foundation for application themes and every styled Kerf UI component.
- [Document baseline](./document-baseline.md) — Let an application opt into Kerf UI-owned document defaults and a definite full-height chain for a percentage-height application shell.
- [Application layout](./layout.md) — Provide one reusable pane, toolbar, content stack, and content-item geometry across sidebars, main areas, and dialogs.

## Kerf UI — Structure

- [Pane](./pane.md) — Organize a sidebar, main area, inspector, or dialog column into fixed vertical header/footer chrome around one scrolling content owner.
- [NavStack](./nav-stack.md) — Present a single linear or drill-down flow while preserving each prior view's state, scroll position, and place in the stack.
- [SplitView](./split-view.md) — Present a selectable list and its detail together when space permits, with a one-pane drill-down replacement on compact devices.
- [TabScaffold](./tab-scaffold.md) — Switch among two to five co-equal top-level destinations on compact devices while preserving each destination's independent content state.
- [Workbench](./workbench.md) — Arrange a complex tool or editor as a stable central work area with optional peripheral rails and a bottom drawer.
- [CollapsiblePanel](./collapsible-panel.md) — Add one independently collapsible peripheral panel without adopting the complete multi-panel Workbench shell.
- [SunkenPanel](./sunken-panel.md) — Group a vertical list of application content on a visually lowered surface with one owned 8px inset and an explicit rounded or square-corner shape.
- [Toolbar](./toolbar.md) — Leading, centered, and trailing toolbar composition.
- [ToolbarControlGroup](./toolbar-control-group.md) — Provide complete toolbar action geometry through configuration, including semantic anchors, overflow containment, and dropdown menu insets without application CSS.
- [Surface scaffolds](./surface-scaffold.md) — Configure recurring dialog and popup geometry without consumer ::part() overrides.
- [FloatingToolbar](./floating-toolbar.md) — A transparent, forced-dark toolbar that floats over its container's content.
- [ToolbarText](./toolbar-text.md) — Extra-large through extra-small toolbar identity text.
- [Text](./text.md) — Render paragraph semantics by default, h1 through h6 when selected, or geometry-free inline secondary text as a span while independently configuring quiet or danger tone, compact through extra-large size, or monospace font.
- [Headers](./headers.md) — Page, dialog, and definition-list hierarchy.
- [ValueTable](./value-table.md) — Key/value rows with optional icons and aligned separators.
- [Row](./row.md) — Arrange related content horizontally with consistent spacing, optional physical-side text/control insets, and explicit left/center/right/full plus top/middle/bottom/full/baseline alignment instead of application-owned flex wrappers.
- [Grid](./grid.md) — Arrange related siblings in equal-width columns without repeating application-owned grid-template-columns CSS.
- [Spacer](./spacer.md) — Express an intentional empty dimension or consume remaining flex space without application-owned spacer markup or raw CSS lengths.
- [ListInsetControl](./list-inset-control.md) — Apply the standard 8px outer margin to all physical sides of a self-bordered control by default, or only the sides selected with the canonical Sides contract.
- [ListInsetText](./list-inset-text.md) — Apply the full 8px margin + 1px transparent border + 8px padding to all physical sides of bare text by default, or only the sides selected with the canonical Sides contract.
- [ContentItem](./content-item.md) — Render one self-contained .kui-content child that owns its 8px inline margin, real 1px border, 8px padding, and radius, with framing and shape chosen by typed props instead of hand-written modifier classes.

## Kerf UI — Navigation

- [List](./list.md) — Standardize vertical component layout, optional physical-side text/control insets, and scroll/divider ownership instead of repeating ad-hoc flex-column wrappers.
- [ListHeader](./list-header.md) — Fill the available section width by default, or shrink-wrap without outer geometry when inline, while splitting a dormant title and mutually exclusive semantic count or badge from an optional logical-end action with an 18px visual; disclosure mode renders the title cluster as a button with a default production DisclosureArrow.
- [ListActionRow](./list-action-row.md) — Keep a selectable primary row action and an independently named trailing action as sibling native controls inside one noninteractive visual row.
- [ListItem](./list-item.md) — Selectable, disabled, trailing, and multiline navigation rows.
- [Application tabs](./application-tabs.md) — Show AppTab and TabBar in a complete controlled composition.
- [AppTab](./tabs.md) — Roving-tabindex-ready tabs with typed compact, segmented, icon-only, and truncating-label presentations.
- [TabBar](./tab-bar.md) — Controlled tab strips whose tabs shrink and scroll while fixed leading, trailing, and far-edge end actions remain visible.

## Kerf UI — Controls

- [SegmentedControl](./segmented-control.md) — Controlled exclusive choices in toolbar, rounded-rectangle, and pill presentations.
- [TokenSearchField](./token-search-field.md) — Token-controlled, optionally collapsible search editor with ordered, editable, removable filter chips.
- [ResizableRegion](./resize.md) — Pointer and keyboard-operable split region with a customizable handle icon.
- [Select](./select.md) — Controlled Web Awesome select with typed form, toolbar, navigation, compact, icon-only, truncating, hint, and grouped-choice presentations.
- [PopupMenu](./popup-menu.md) — A typed action menu with nested choices, selected state, and optional pointer-anchored context opening, built on the Web Awesome dropdown.

## Kerf UI — Feedback

- [Feedback](./feedback.md) — Banners, empty states, and labeled progress.
- [StateBanner](./state-banner.md) — Present persistent inline feedback or attractive non-status emphasis with a named semantic tone.
- [EmptyState](./empty-state.md) — Actionable empty and busy content states.
- [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md) — Meaningfully labeled or decorative progress.
- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md) — A subtle, unanimated loading placeholder block for a not-yet-known value slot.

## Web Awesome — Actions

- [Button](./wa-button.md) — Action control with semantic variants, appearances, loading, and icon support.
- [Button Group](./wa-button-group.md) (conditional) — Exceptional grouped actions; prefer Kerf SegmentedControl for exclusive choices.
- [Copy Button](./wa-copy-button.md) — Copies a supplied value and announces success or failure.
- [Dropdown](./wa-dropdown.md) (conditional) — Action-menu primitive; prefer Kerf Select when choosing a value.
- [Dropdown Item](./wa-dropdown-item.md) (conditional) — Action-menu row; prefer Kerf Select options for value selection.

## Web Awesome — Forms

- [Checkbox](./wa-checkbox.md) — Binary form control with checked, indeterminate, and disabled states.
- [Checkbox Group](./wa-checkbox-group.md) — Labels and validates a related set of checkboxes.
- [Color Picker](./wa-color-picker.md) — Color input with swatches, formats, opacity, and eyedropper support.
- [Input](./wa-input.md) — Text input with labels, hints, clear controls, and semantic appearances.
- [Known Date](./wa-known-date.md) — Experimental segmented field for partially or fully known dates.
- [Number Input](./wa-number-input.md) — Numeric input with keyboard and stepper controls.
- [Option](./wa-option.md) (underlying) — Underlying ecosystem option; prefer choices passed to Kerf Select.
- [OTP Input](./wa-otp-input.md) — Experimental segmented one-time-password input.
- [Radio](./wa-radio.md) — Single-choice control used inside a radio group.
- [Radio Group](./wa-radio-group.md) — Labels and manages a mutually exclusive set of radios.
- [Rating](./wa-rating.md) — Interactive rating control with accessible labeling.
- [Select](./wa-select.md) (underlying) — Underlying ecosystem field; prefer Kerf Select for app UI.
- [Slider](./wa-slider.md) — Range input with markers and value tooltip support.
- [Switch](./wa-switch.md) — Immediate on/off setting control.
- [Textarea](./wa-textarea.md) — Multiline text field with labels, hints, and resize behavior.
- [Time Input](./wa-time-input.md) — Experimental segmented time field with an optional picker.

## Web Awesome — Layout

- [Accordion](./wa-accordion.md) — Coordinates one or more collapsible content sections.
- [Accordion Item](./wa-accordion-item.md) — Experimental labeled disclosure section used by an accordion.
- [Card](./wa-card.md) — Groups related content and optional header, media, and footer slots.
- [Details](./wa-details.md) — Single disclosure panel for secondary information.
- [Dialog](./wa-dialog.md) — Modal surface for focused tasks and confirmations.
- [Divider](./wa-divider.md) — Visual separator for related groups of content.
- [Drawer](./wa-drawer.md) — Edge-anchored modal surface for navigation or secondary tasks.
- [Page](./wa-page.md) — Responsive application shell with navigation, banner, and main slots.
- [Scroller](./wa-scroller.md) — Overflow container with accessible scrolling affordances.
- [Split Panel](./wa-split-panel.md) (conditional) — Alternative split API; prefer Kerf ResizableRegion for application panes.

## Web Awesome — Navigation

- [Breadcrumb](./wa-breadcrumb.md) — Ordered navigation trail for the current location.
- [Breadcrumb Item](./wa-breadcrumb-item.md) — One link or current-location item in a breadcrumb.
- [Pagination](./wa-pagination.md) — Experimental page navigation for a bounded result set.
- [Tab](./wa-tab.md) (conditional) — Ecosystem tab label; prefer Kerf TabBar or SegmentedControl.
- [Tab Group](./wa-tab-group.md) (conditional) — Ecosystem tabs; prefer Kerf TabBar or SegmentedControl.
- [Tab Panel](./wa-tab-panel.md) (conditional) — Ecosystem tab panel; prefer app-owned panels with Kerf navigation.
- [Tree](./wa-tree.md) (exceptional) — Specialized hierarchy; use only when the product requires tree behavior.
- [Tree Item](./wa-tree-item.md) (exceptional) — Specialized tree row; use only as part of a required tree.

## Web Awesome — Feedback

- [Badge](./wa-badge.md) — Compact status or count label with semantic variants.
- [Callout](./wa-callout.md) — Prominent contextual message with semantic variants.
- [Progress Bar](./wa-progress-bar.md) — Linear indicator for determinate or indeterminate progress.
- [Progress Ring](./wa-progress-ring.md) — Circular indicator for determinate or indeterminate progress.
- [Skeleton](./wa-skeleton.md) — Placeholder shape for content that is still loading.
- [Spinner](./wa-spinner.md) — Compact indeterminate activity indicator.
- [Tag](./wa-tag.md) — Compact categorization label with optional removal action.
- [Toast](./wa-toast.md) — Placement-aware stack of transient notifications.
- [Toast Item](./wa-toast-item.md) — One dismissible notification inside a toast stack.
- [Tooltip](./wa-tooltip.md) — Brief contextual label anchored to a control.

## Web Awesome — Media

- [Animated Image](./wa-animated-image.md) (exceptional) — Specialized animated media; use only for a concrete product requirement.
- [Avatar](./wa-avatar.md) — Person or entity image with initials fallback.
- [Carousel](./wa-carousel.md) — Navigable horizontal or vertical collection of slides.
- [Carousel Item](./wa-carousel-item.md) — One content slide inside a carousel.
- [Comparison](./wa-comparison.md) (exceptional) — Specialized before-and-after media; use only when specifically required.
- [Icon](./wa-icon.md) (avoid) — Ecosystem icon renderer; use Kerf LucideIcon in application UI.
- [Markdown](./wa-markdown.md) — Experimental renderer for trusted Markdown content.
- [QR Code](./wa-qr-code.md) — Scannable QR representation of a supplied value.
- [Zoomable Frame](./wa-zoomable-frame.md) (avoid) — Avoid for application UI; keep embedded-media behavior application-owned.

## Web Awesome — Helpers

- [Animation](./wa-animation.md) — Declarative Web Animations API wrapper with preset effects.
- [Format Bytes](./wa-format-bytes.md) — Locale-aware byte and bit value formatter.
- [Format Date](./wa-format-date.md) — Locale-aware date and time formatter.
- [Format Number](./wa-format-number.md) — Locale-aware number, currency, unit, and percentage formatter.
- [Include](./wa-include.md) — Loads and injects an external HTML fragment.
- [Intersection Observer](./wa-intersection-observer.md) — Declaratively emits visibility changes for slotted content.
- [Mutation Observer](./wa-mutation-observer.md) — Declaratively emits DOM mutation records for slotted content.
- [Popover](./wa-popover.md) — Anchored non-modal surface built on popup positioning.
- [Popup](./wa-popup.md) (conditional) — Preferred low-level anchored positioning when Tooltip or Popover do not fit.
- [Random Content](./wa-random-content.md) — Experimental helper that selects one slotted item at random.
- [Relative Time](./wa-relative-time.md) — Locale-aware human description of a date relative to now.
- [Resize Observer](./wa-resize-observer.md) — Declaratively emits size changes for slotted content.

## Kerf UI — Recipes

- [Desktop application shell](./recipe-app-shell.md) — App bar above a Workbench with resizable navigation and inspector rails, relocated rail toggles, narrow-container overlays, and explicit pane scroll owners.
- [Navigation sidebar](./recipe-navigation-sidebar.md) — Navigation sections with icon and iconless rows, a content-item surface, disclosure, and pane footer actions.
- [Workspace header](./recipe-workspace-header.md) — Page identity with primary, secondary, and overflow actions that relocate at narrow widths.
- [List-detail dialog](./recipe-list-detail-dialog.md) — Production modal laid out as a workbench: a full-height SplitView list sidebar with its own toolbar beside a full-height detail column that carries the primary title, close control, and record actions; a full-screen drill-down on compact devices.
- [Composer form](./recipe-composer-form.md) — One visible publishing-form surface with Toolbar heading hierarchy, fields and actions on the shared 8px control gutter, 24px major rhythm, and a conditional StateBanner as its only nested semantic surface.
- [List workspace states](./recipe-list-workspace-states.md) — Deterministic loading, empty, populated, stale refresh, and error states around one stable list workspace.
- [Compact toolbar choices and actions](./recipe-compact-toolbar.md) — A compact toolbar that distinguishes grouped commands, a visible exclusive choice, a longer Select, and one ordinary action.
- [Navigation stack](./recipe-navigation-stack.md) — A push/pop navigation stack drill-down with animated slides and a live device class.
- [Loading inspector](./recipe-loading-inspector.md) — A record inspector whose per-record values load asynchronously — every value-bearing component takes a shared placeholder flag, so the same chrome renders a faithful loading state and then the populated record.
- [Collapsible sidebar](./recipe-collapsible-sidebar.md) — A mini app frame whose left navigation rail and bottom activity drawer are standalone CollapsiblePanels driven by wireSidebar: per-side collapse/expand toggles, focus move-in and restore, a dismissable compact overlay, and per-panel persistence.
